title.zh: 卷十 陳本紀下第十 宣帝 後主
title.en: Volume 10 Chen Annals 2: Emperor Xuan, Later Rulers
title.raw: 卷十 陳本紀下第十 宣帝 後主 Volume 10 Chen Annals 2: Emperor Xuan, Later Rulers

sentences.zh: 陳本紀下第十

translations.literal: Chen Annals, Lower Fascicle Ten
translations.idiomatic: Chen Annals 2, Part Ten

sentences.zh: 高宗孝宣皇帝諱頊，字紹世，小字師利，始興昭烈王第二子也。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor, Filial and Eminent Emperor, taboo name Xu, courtesy name Shaoshi, childhood name Shili, was the second son of the Zhaolie Prince of Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan, the Filial and Eminent High Ancestor, personal name Xu, style Shaoshi, childhood name Shili, was the second son of Shixing's Zhaolie Prince.

sentences.zh: 梁中大通二年七月辛酉生，有赤光滿室。

translations.literal: Born on xinyou of the seventh month, second year of Zhongdatong of Liang; red light filled the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on xinyou, seventh month, second year of Liang Zhongdatong, and crimson light flooded the room.

sentences.zh: 少寬容，多智略。

translations.literal: In youth he was tolerant and possessed much strategy.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he was broad-minded and full of stratagem.

sentences.zh: 及長，美容儀，身長八尺三寸，垂手過膝，有勇力，善騎射。

translations.literal: When grown he had fine appearance; his body was eight chi three cun tall, his hands reached below his knees, he had courage and strength, and excelled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Grown to manhood he was handsome, stood eight chi three cun, his fingertips passed his knees, he was bold and strong, and skilled at riding and shooting.

sentences.zh: 武帝平侯景，鎮京口，梁元帝征武帝子侄入侍，武帝遣帝赴江陵。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu pacified Hou Jing and garrisoned Jingkou, Emperor Yuan of Liang summoned Wu's sons and nephews to attend court; Wu sent the Emperor to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wu crushed Hou Jing and held Jingkou, Liang Emperor Yuan called Wu's sons and nephews to court service, and Wu dispatched the future emperor to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 累官為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Through successive posts he reached Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive offices to Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時有軍主李總與帝有舊，每同遊處，帝嘗夜被酒，張燈而寐，總適出，尋反，乃見帝是大龍，便驚走他室。

translations.literal: At the time the garrison commander Li Zong was old friends with the Emperor and often kept company with him. Once the Emperor, drunk at night, slept with lamps lit; Zong happened to go out and soon returned, then saw the Emperor was a great dragon and fled in alarm to another room.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commander Li Zong, an old companion, often kept him company. One night, drunk and asleep with lamps burning, Zong stepped out briefly; on returning he saw a great dragon where the Emperor lay and fled in terror to another room.

sentences.zh: 魏平江陵，遷于長安。

translations.literal: When Wei pacified Jiangling, he was moved to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei took Jiangling he was transferred to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 帝貌若不慧，魏將楊忠門客張子煦見而奇之，曰：「此人虎頭，當大貴也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor's mien seemed dull; Zhang Zixu, a retainer of the Wei general Yang Zhong, saw him and marveled, saying: "This man's tiger head will bring great nobility."
translations.idiomatic: He seemed slow-witted in appearance, but Zhang Zixu, retainer to the Wei general Yang Zhong, took him for extraordinary and said, "That tiger's brow marks a man destined for greatness."

sentences.zh: 是月，齊武成帝殂。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Wucheng of Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Northern Qi Emperor Wucheng died.

sentences.zh: 太建元年春正月甲午，皇帝即位于太極前殿，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, jiawu of the first year of Taijian, the Emperor took the throne in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month, jiawu, first year of Taijian: he ascended the throne in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate, declared a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位一階，孝悌力田及為父後者，賜爵一級，鰥寡不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials received one rank; the filial, the brotherly, those who tilled fields by their own labor, and those who headed their fathers' households were granted one degree of nobility; widowers and widows unable to support themselves were each given five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military ranks rose one step; the filial, the brotherly, field-tillers, and household heads received one noble rank; indigent widowers and widows got five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 復太皇太后尊號曰皇太后。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager's honorific was restored to Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager was again styled Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 立妃柳氏為皇后，世子叔寶為皇太子。

translations.literal: Consort Liu was installed as Empress, and the heir Shubao as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Liu became Empress and heir Shubao Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 封皇子江州刺史康樂侯叔陵為始興王，奉昭烈王祀。

translations.literal: The prince, Marquis of Kangle of Jiangzhou, Shuling, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing to maintain the rites of the Zhaolie Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shuling, Marquis of Kangle and governor of Jiangzhou, was created Prince of Shixing to keep the Zhaolie Prince's cult.

sentences.zh: 乙未，謁太廟。

translations.literal: On yimou he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yimou he worshipped at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，分命大使，觀省四方風俗。

translations.literal: On dingyou he separately commissioned grand envoys to inspect customs throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he dispatched grand envoys to survey customs in every quarter.

sentences.zh: 以尚書僕射沈欽為左僕射，度支尚書王勱為右僕射。

translations.literal: Shen Qin, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director; Wang Li, Director of the Revenue Section, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Qin, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Vice Director; Wang Li, Director of the Revenue Section, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinchou he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he offered sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，封皇子建安侯叔英為豫章王，豐城侯叔堅為長沙王。

translations.literal: On renyin he enfeoffed Prince Shuying, Marquis of Jian'an, as Prince of Yuzhang, and Prince Shujian, Marquis of Fengcheng, as Prince of Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince Shuying, Marquis of Jian'an, was made Prince of Yuzhang, and Prince Shujian, Marquis of Fengcheng, Prince of Changsha.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month, yihai, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: he performed the spring plowing at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲午，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, jiawu, envoys came from Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, jiawu: Qi sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以吏部尚書徐陵為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On dingsi Xu Ling, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xu Ling, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，皇太子納妃沈氏，王公以下賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, xinmao, the Crown Prince took Lady Shen as consort; nobles and officials received silk in graded gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinmao: the Crown Prince married Lady Shen; nobles and officials received graded gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，新除左衛將軍歐陽紇據廣州反。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, the newly appointed General of the Left Guard Ouyang He seized Guangzhou in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month: the newly appointed General of the Left Guard Ouyang He rebelled and held Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣開府儀同三司章昭達討之。

translations.literal: On xinwei he dispatched Zhang Zhaoda, Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order, to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he sent Zhang Zhaoda, Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order, against him.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月癸未，章昭達禽歐陽紇送都，斬于建康市，廣州平。

translations.literal: In spring, second month, guiwei of the second year, Zhang Zhaoda captured Ouyang He and sent him to the capital; he was beheaded in the Jiankang market and Guangzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, second month, guiwei: Zhang Zhaoda seized Ouyang He, sent him to court, and had him executed in the Jiankang market; Guangzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: In the third month, bingshen, the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingshen: the Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，曲赦廣、衡二州。

translations.literal: On bingwu a partial amnesty was granted for Guang and Heng provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu a partial amnesty covered Guang and Heng provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦。

translations.literal: On dingwei a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 又詔自討周迪、華皎以來，兵所有死亡者，並令收斂，並給棺槥，送還本鄉。

translations.literal: An edict further ordered that all who had died in arms since the campaigns against Zhou Di and Hua Jiao were to be gathered in, given coffins, and sent back to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered the dead from the campaigns against Zhou Di and Hua Jiao collected, coffined, and returned to their home districts.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，新羅國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, wuzi, Silla sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuzi: Silla sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大雨雹。

translations.literal: On xinmao great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao hail fell heavily.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，分遣大使巡州郡，省冤屈。

translations.literal: On yisi grand envoys were separately dispatched to tour the provinces and commanderies and review wrongful cases.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi separate grand envoys toured provinces and commanderies to redress injustice.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, xinyou, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, xinyou: Goguryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，雷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, guisi, thunder sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guisi: thunder.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，以尚書右僕射徐陵為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, guichou of the third year, Xu Ling, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, guichou: Xu Ling, Right Vice Director, became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinyou he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month, xinsi, he sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinsi: he sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，耕藉田。

translations.literal: On dingyou he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, dingchou, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingchou: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, renchen, envoys came from Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, renchen: Qi sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，高麗、新羅、丹丹、天竺、盤盤等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, xinhai, Goguryeo, Silla, Dandan, Tianzhu, Panpan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinhai: Goguryeo, Silla, Dandan, Tianzhu, Panpan, and others sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，江陰王蕭季卿以罪免。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, dinghai, Prince of Jiangyin Xiao Jiqing was removed from office for crime.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dinghai: Prince of Jiangyin Xiao Jiqing was dismissed for crime.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，封東中郎長沙王府諮議參軍蕭彝為江陰王。

translations.literal: On jiachen Xiao Yi, Consultant of the Eastern Palace of the Prince of Changsha, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xiao Yi, consultant in the Eastern Palace of the Prince of Changsha, was created Prince of Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，周人來聘。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, yiyou, envoys came from Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, yiyou: Zhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，司空章昭達薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, renchen, Minister of Works Zhang Zhaoda died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen: Minister of Works Zhang Zhaoda died.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙午，以尚書僕射徐陵為左僕射，中書監王勱為右僕射。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, bingwu of the fourth year, Xu Ling, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director, and Wang Li, Director of the Secretariat, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, bingwu: Xu Ling became Left Vice Director; Wang Li, Director of the Secretariat, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，立皇子叔卿為建安王。

translations.literal: In the second month, yiyou, Prince Shuqing was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiyou: Prince Shuqing was created Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，扶南、林邑國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, yichou, Funan and Linyi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yichou: Funan and Linyi sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸卯，尚書右僕射王勱卒。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, guimao, Wang Li, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, guimao: Right Vice Director Wang Li died.

sentences.zh: 是月周人誅塚宰宇文護。

translations.literal: That month Zhou executed the regent Yuwen Hu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou executed the regent Yuwen Hu.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛未，周人來聘。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, xinwei, envoys came from Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, eighth month, xinwei: Zhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, gengzi, first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengzi, new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinhai a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以故太尉徐度，儀同三司杜棱、程靈洗配食武帝廟庭；

translations.literal: On bingyin the late Grand Commandant Xu Du, Commissioners with the Grand Precedence of the First Order Du Ling and Cheng Lingxi, were given paired offerings in Emperor Wu's temple hall;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the late Grand Commandant Xu Du and Commissioners Du Ling and Cheng Lingxi were granted paired offerings in Emperor Wu's temple;

sentences.zh: 故司空章昭達配食文帝廟庭。

translations.literal: the late Minister of Works Zhang Zhaoda was given paired offerings in Emperor Wen's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: the late Minister of Works Zhang Zhaoda received paired offerings in Emperor Wen's temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己亥，地震。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, jihai, an earthquake occurred.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, jihai: earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周建德元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Jiande of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year was Zhou Jiande 1.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸酉，以吏部尚書沈君理為尚書右僕射，領吏部。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, guiyou of the fifth year, Shen Junli, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing while retaining the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, spring, first month, guiyou: Shen Junli, Director of Personnel, became Right Vice Director while keeping Personnel.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinsi he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month, xinchou, he sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinchou: he sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯夜，有白氣如虹，自北方貫北斗紫宮。

translations.literal: On the night of yimao a white vapor like a rainbow ran from the north through the Northern Dipper and the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yimao a white vapor like a rainbow streaked from the north through the Northern Dipper and the Purple Palace.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，以開府儀同三司吳明徹都督征討諸軍事，略地北邊。

translations.literal: In the third month, renwu, Wu Mingche, Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order, was made overall commander of the punitive expedition and advanced into the northern borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renwu: Wu Mingche, Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order, took overall command of the punitive expedition and pushed into the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，西衡州獻馬生角。

translations.literal: On bingxu Xihheng Province presented a horse born with horns.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Xihheng Province presented a horned foal.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇孫胤生，內外文武賜帛各有差，為父後者賜爵一級。

translations.literal: On jichou the imperial grandson Yin was born; civil and military officials within and without the palace received graded gifts of silk, and those who headed their fathers' households one degree of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou imperial grandson Yin was born; court and field officials received graded silk gifts, and household heads one noble rank.

sentences.zh: 夏六月癸亥，周人來聘。

translations.literal: In summer, sixth month, guihai, envoys came from Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, sixth month, guihai: Zhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 秋九月癸未，尚書右僕射沈君理卒。

translations.literal: In autumn, ninth month, guiwei, Shen Junli, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, ninth month, guiwei: Right Vice Director Shen Junli died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰晦，夜明。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, renchen, the night was bright.
translations.idiomatic: Month's end, renchen: the night shone bright.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，以特進周弘正為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, jihai, Zhou Hongzheng, Special Advance, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jihai: Zhou Hongzheng, Special Advance, became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吳明徹克壽陽城，斬王琳，傳首建鄴，梟於朱雀航。

translations.literal: On yisi Wu Mingche took Shouyang city, beheaded Wang Lin, sent his head to Jiankang, and displayed it at the Zhuque ferry.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wu Mingche stormed Shouyang, beheaded Wang Lin, sent his head to Jiankang, and displayed it at the Zhuque ferry.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，詔熊曇朗、留異、陳寶應、周迪、鄧緒等及王琳首並還親屬，以弘廣宥。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, renchen, an edict ordered the heads of Xiong Tanlang, Liu Yi, Chen Baoying, Zhou Di, Deng Xu, and Wang Lin, together with their kin, returned to their families in broad clemency.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen: an edict returned the heads of Xiong Tanlang, Liu Yi, Chen Baoying, Zhou Di, Deng Xu, and Wang Lin to their kin in broad mercy.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，立皇子叔明為宜都王，叔獻為河東王。

translations.literal: On yisi Prince Shuming was enfeoffed as Prince of Yidu and Prince Shuxian as Prince of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Prince Shuming became Prince of Yidu and Prince Shuxian Prince of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸軍略地，所在克捷。

translations.literal: That year the armies on campaign seized territory everywhere with repeated success.
translations.idiomatic: That year campaigning armies won victory after victory wherever they advanced.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月壬戌，赦江右淮北諸州。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, renxu of the sixth year, an amnesty was granted for the provinces east of the river and north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, spring, first month, renxu: amnesty for provinces east of the river and north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 甲申，周人來聘。

translations.literal: On jiashen envoys came from Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the second month, renchen, first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renchen, new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: On xinhai he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，彗星見。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, gengzi, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, gengzi: a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，尚書右僕射周弘正卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, renchen, Zhou Hongzheng, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: Right Vice Director Zhou Hongzheng died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙亥，詔北邊行軍之所，並給復十年。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, yihai, an edict granted ten years' tax remission to all places where northern campaigns marched.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, yihai: an edict granted ten years' remission where northern campaigns had marched.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，以吏部尚書王瑒為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, wuxu, Wang Yang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuxu: Wang Yang, Director of Personnel, became Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛未，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, xinwei of the seventh year, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, spring, first month, xinwei: sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔豫、二兗、譙、徐、合、霍、南司、定九州及南豫、江、郢所部在江北諸郡，置雲旗義士，往大軍及諸鎮備防。

translations.literal: In the third month, xinwei, an edict ordered that in the nine provinces of Yu, the two Yans, Qiao, Xu, He, Huo, Nansi, and Ding, and in the northern commanderies of Jiang, E, and Ying under Southern Yu and Southern E, Cloud-Banner volunteers be posted to the great army and garrisons for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinwei: an edict raised Cloud-Banner volunteers across nine provinces and the Huai-north commanderies of Jiang, E, and Ying for the main army and frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，有星孛於大角。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, bingxu, a broom star appeared at the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingxu: a broom star appeared at the Horn.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，監豫州陳桃根獻青牛，詔以還百姓。

translations.literal: On gengyin Chen Taogen, overseer of Yu Province, presented a blue ox; an edict returned it to the common people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Chen Taogen, overseer of Yu Province, presented a blue ox; an edict returned it to the people.

sentences.zh: 乙未，桃根又上織成羅紋錦被表各二，詔于雲龍門外焚之。

translations.literal: On yiwei Taogen again submitted two brocade quilts woven with patterned silk; an edict ordered them burned outside the Cloud-Dragon Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Taogen again offered two brocade quilts with patterned silk; an edict burned them outside the Cloud-Dragon Gate.

sentences.zh: 壬子，郢州獻瑞鍾六。

translations.literal: On renzi E Province presented six auspicious bells.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi E Province presented six auspicious bells.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，詔為北行將士死王事者，克日舉哀。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, bingxu, an edict ordered mourning on a fixed day for officers who died in service on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingxu: an edict fixed a day of mourning for officers who died on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以尚書右僕射王瑒為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On renchen Wang Yang, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Wang Yang, Right Vice Director, became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，改作雲龍、神獸門。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Cloud-Dragon and Spirit-Beast gates were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Cloud-Dragon and Spirit-Beast gates were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸卯，周人來聘。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, guimao, envoys came from Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, eighth month, guimao: Zhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 閏九月壬辰，都督吳明徹大破齊軍于呂梁。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, renchen, Wu Mingche, overall commander, routed the Qi army at Lüliang.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary ninth month, renchen: overall commander Wu Mingche crushed the Qi army at Lüliang.

sentences.zh: 是月，甘露頻降樂游苑。

translations.literal: That month sweet dew repeatedly fell in the Pleasure-Travel Park.
translations.idiomatic: That month sweet dew fell again and again in the Pleasure-Travel Park.

sentences.zh: 丁未，輿駕幸苑采甘露，宴群臣，詔于苑龍舟山立甘露亭。

translations.literal: On dingwei the imperial carriage visited the park to gather sweet dew and feasted the assembled ministers; an edict ordered a Sweet-Dew Pavilion erected on Dragon-Boat Hill in the park.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor visited the park to collect sweet dew and feasted the ministers; an edict raised a Sweet-Dew Pavilion on Dragon-Boat Hill.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，立皇子叔齊為新蔡王，叔文為晉熙王。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, jisi, Prince Shuqi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xincai and Prince Shuwen as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jisi: Prince Shuqi became Prince of Xincai and Prince Shuwen Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，以尚書僕射王瑒為左僕射，太子詹事陸繕為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, renxu, Wang Yang, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director, and Lu Shan, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renxu: Wang Yang became Left Vice Director; Lu Shan, Grand Mentor of the Heir, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 甲子，南康郡獻瑞鍾一。

translations.literal: On jiazi Nankang commandery presented one auspicious bell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Nankang commandery presented one auspicious bell.

sentences.zh: 八年春二月壬申，以開府儀同三司吳明徹為司空。

translations.literal: In spring, second month, renshen of the eighth year, Wu Mingche, Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, spring, second month, renshen: Wu Mingche, Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order, became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚寅，尚書左僕射王瑒卒。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, gengyin, Wang Yang, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, gengyin: Left Vice Director Wang Yang died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，以尚書右僕射陸繕為左僕射，新除晉陵太守王克為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, jiayin, Lu Shan, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director, and Wang Ke, newly appointed Administrator of Jinling, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiayin: Lu Shan became Left Vice Director; Wang Ke, newly appointed Administrator of Jinling, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 秋九月戊戌，立皇子叔彪為淮南王。

translations.literal: In autumn, ninth month, wuxu, Prince Shubiao was enfeoffed as Prince of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, ninth month, wuxu: Prince Shubiao was created Prince of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙亥，齊主傳位於其太子恒，自號太上皇。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, yihai of the ninth year, the ruler of Qi transferred the throne to his heir Heng and styled himself Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year, spring, first month, yihai: the Qi ruler abdicated to his heir Heng and styled himself Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是月，周滅齊。

translations.literal: That month Zhou destroyed Qi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou destroyed Qi.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month, renzi, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renzi: he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，百濟國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, jimao, Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, jimao: Baekje sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大雨，震萬安陵華表。

translations.literal: On gengchen great rain fell and lightning struck the ornamental column of Wan'an Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen heavy rain fell and lightning struck the ornamental column of Wan'an Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己丑，震慧日寺刹及瓦官寺重門，一女子震死。

translations.literal: On jichou lightning struck the pagoda of Huiri Temple and the double gate of Waguan Temple; one woman was killed by the strike.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou lightning struck Huiri Temple's pagoda and Waguan Temple's double gate; one woman was killed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，司空吳明徹破周將梁士彥于呂梁。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, wuwu, Minister of Works Wu Mingche defeated the Zhou general Liang Shiyan at Lüliang.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, wuwu: Minister of Works Wu Mingche defeated Zhou general Liang Shiyan at Lüliang.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，東宮成，皇太子移于新宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, wushen, the Eastern Palace was completed and the Crown Prince moved to the new palace.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen: the Eastern Palace was finished and the Crown Prince moved in.

sentences.zh: 十年春二月甲子，周軍救梁士彥，大敗司空吳明徹于呂梁，及將卒皆見囚俘不反。

translations.literal: In spring, second month, jiazi of the tenth year, Zhou armies came to rescue Liang Shiyan and routed Minister of Works Wu Mingche at Lüliang; officers and soldiers were all taken captive and did not return.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, spring, second month, jiazi: Zhou forces rescued Liang Shiyan and crushed Wu Mingche at Lüliang; officers and men were captured and never returned.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，震武庫。

translations.literal: In the third month, xinwei, the armory was struck by lightning.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinwei: lightning struck the armory.

sentences.zh: 丙子，分命眾軍以備周。

translations.literal: On bingzi he separately ordered the armies to prepare against Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he ordered the armies to ready defenses against Zhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大赦。

translations.literal: On yiyou a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，詔絓在軍者，並賜爵二級。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, gengxu, an edict granted two degrees of nobility to all in the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, gengxu: an edict granted two noble ranks to all under arms.

sentences.zh: 又詔禦府堂署所營造，禮樂儀服軍器之外，悉皆停息。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that construction by the imperial workshops and palace offices, apart from ritual implements, ceremonial dress, and military equipment, all cease.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict halted all imperial workshop construction save ritual gear, ceremonial dress, and arms.

sentences.zh: 掖庭常供，王侯妃主諸有奉恤者，並各量減。

translations.literal: Regular supplies to the inner palace and stipends to princes, consorts, and princesses were each reduced according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-palace rations and stipends to princes, consorts, and princesses were cut proportionately.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大雨雹。

translations.literal: On gengshen great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen hail fell heavily.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，周武帝崩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, dingyou, Emperor Wu of Zhou died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingyou: Zhou Emperor Wu died.

sentences.zh: 閏六月丁卯，大雨，震大皇寺刹、莊嚴寺露盤、重陽閣東樓、千秋門內槐樹及鴻臚府門。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, dingmao, heavy rain fell and lightning struck the pagoda of Dahuang Temple, the dew basin of Zhuangyan Temple, the east tower of Chongyang Pavilion, the pagoda tree inside the Gate of a Thousand Autumns, and the gate of the Office of the Grand Herald.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month, dingmao: heavy rain and lightning struck Dahuang Temple's pagoda, Zhuangyan Temple's dew basin, Chongyang Pavilion's east tower, the pagoda tree inside the Gate of a Thousand Autumns, and the Grand Herald's gate.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，新羅國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, wuxu, Silla sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu: Silla sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，隕霜殺稻菽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, wuyin, frost fell and killed rice and beans.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuyin: killing frost destroyed rice and beans.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，立方明壇于婁湖。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, yisi, the Square Bright Altar was erected at Lou Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yisi: the Square Bright Altar was raised at Lou Lake.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以揚州刺史始興王叔陵兼王官伯，臨盟。

translations.literal: On wushen Prince Shuling of Shixing, concurrently governor of Yangzhou and chief of princely officials, was sent to oversee the covenant.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Prince Shuling of Shixing, governor of Yangzhou and chief of princely officials, was sent to preside at the covenant.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸婁湖，臨誓眾。

translations.literal: On jiayin he visited Lou Lake and reviewed the oath before the assembled troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he visited Lou Lake and reviewed the troops' oath.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分遣大使以盟誓班下四方，以上下相警。

translations.literal: On yimao grand envoys were separately dispatched to circulate the covenant oath throughout the realm so that high and low might warn one another.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao grand envoys circulated the covenant oath through the realm as a warning to all ranks.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，以尚書左僕射陸繕為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, wuzi, Lu Shan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, wuzi: Lu Shan became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月丁酉，南兗州言龍見。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, dingyou of the eleventh year, Nanyang Province reported a dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year, spring, first month, dingyou: Nanyang Province reported a dragon sighting.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month, guihai, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guihai: he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，初用大貨六銖錢。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, xinmao, the Great Value six-zhu coin was first put into use.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinmao: the Great Value six-zhu coin entered circulation.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，幸大壯觀閱武。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, dingmao, he visited the Great Strength Watchtower to review martial exercises.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingmao: he reviewed troops at the Great Strength Watchtower.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，以尚書僕射陸繕為尚書左僕射，以祠部尚書晉安王伯恭為右僕射。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, jiaxu, Lu Shan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director, and Prince of Jin'an Bokong, Director of the Sacrificial Section, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jiaxu: Lu Shan became Left Vice Director; Prince of Jin'an Bokong, Director of the Sacrificial Section, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, xinmao, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinmao: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，周將梁士彥圍壽陽，克之。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Zhou general Liang Shiyan besieged Shouyang and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhou general Liang Shiyan besieged and took Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，又克霍州。

translations.literal: On xinhai he also took Huo Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he also seized Huo Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以揚州刺史始興王叔陵為大都督，總督水步眾軍。

translations.literal: On guichou Prince Shuling of Shixing, governor of Yangzhou, was made Grand Commander-in-Chief overseeing all land and river forces.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Prince Shuling of Shixing, governor of Yangzhou, became Grand Commander-in-Chief of all land and river forces.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，南、北兗、晉三州及盱眙、山陽、陽平、馬頭、秦、曆陽、沛、北譙、南梁等九郡民並自拔向建鄴。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, yichou, the people of the three provinces of Nan, Bei, and Jin and the nine commanderies of Xuyi, Shanyang, Yangping, Matou, Qin, Liyang, Pei, Beiqiao, and Nanliang all fled of their own accord toward Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yichou: people of Nan, Bei, and Jin provinces and nine Huai-side commanderies fled on their own toward Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 周又克譙、北徐二州。

translations.literal: Zhou also took Qiao and Beixu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou also seized Qiao and Beixu provinces.

sentences.zh: 自是淮南之地，盡歸於周矣。

translations.literal: From this the lands south of the Huai all passed to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the entire Huainan region fell to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔非軍國所須，多所減損，歸於儉約。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict ordered that whatever was not required for state and army be widely reduced and returned to frugality.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict cut all non-military state spending and returned the court to frugality.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周宣帝大象元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Daxiang of Zhou Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: That year was Zhou Daxiang 1 under Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 十二年夏四月癸亥，尚書左僕射陸繕卒。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, guihai of the twelfth year, Lu Shan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year, summer, fourth month, guihai: Left Vice Director Lu Shan died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大雩。

translations.literal: On jimao a great rain sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao: great rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雨。

translations.literal: On renwu rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu: rain.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，以尚書右僕射晉安王伯恭為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, guisi, Prince of Jin'an Bokong, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guisi: Prince of Jin'an Bokong, Right Vice Director, became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，周宣帝崩。

translations.literal: On jiyou Zhou Emperor Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhou Emperor Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，大風，吹壞皋門中闥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, renxu, a great wind blew down the inner gates of the Gaomen.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renxu: a great wind destroyed the Gaomen's inner gates.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己未，周鄖州總管司馬消難以所統九州八鎮之地來降。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, jiwei, Sima Xiaonan, area commander of Yun Province of Zhou, surrendered with the nine provinces and eight garrisons under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, eighth month, jiwei: Zhou's Yun Province area commander Sima Xiaonan surrendered with nine provinces and eight garrisons.

sentences.zh: 詔因以消難為大都督，加司空，封隨郡公。

translations.literal: An edict thereupon made Xiaonan Grand Commander-in-Chief, added the title Minister of Works, and enfeoffed him as Duke of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Xiaonan Grand Commander-in-Chief, added Minister of Works, and enfeoffed him Duke of Sui.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔鎮西將軍樊毅進督沔、漢諸軍事。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict advanced General of the West Fan Yi to oversee the Han and Mian campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict advanced Fan Yi, General of the West, to command the Han and Mian front.

sentences.zh: 遣南豫州刺史任忠率眾趨曆陽，超武將軍陳慧紀為前軍都督，趨南兗州。

translations.literal: Governor of Southern Yu Ren Zhong was sent to hurry troops to Liyang; Super General Chen Huiji was made vanguard commander and hurried to Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Southern Yu Ren Zhong hurried troops to Liyang; Super General Chen Huiji, vanguard commander, hurried to Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以司空司馬消難為大都督水陸諸軍事。

translations.literal: On wuchen Minister of Works Sima Xiaonan was made Grand Commander-in-Chief of all land and river forces.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Minister of Works Sima Xiaonan became Grand Commander-in-Chief of all land and river forces.

sentences.zh: 庚午，通直散騎常侍淳於陵克臨江郡。

translations.literal: On gengwu Attendant Gentleman of the Direct Staff Chunyu Ling took Linjiang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Attendant Gentleman Chunyu Ling took Linjiang commandery.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，智武將軍魯廣達克郭默城。

translations.literal: On guiyou Intelligent Martial General Lu Guangda took Guo Mo's fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Intelligent Martial General Lu Guangda took Guo Mo's fortress.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大雨霖。

translations.literal: On jiaxu prolonged rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu: prolonged rain.

sentences.zh: 丙子，淳於陵克佑州城。

translations.literal: On bingzi Chunyu Ling took You Province city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Chunyu Ling took You Province city.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，周臨江太守劉顯光率眾來降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, guiwei, Liu Xianguang, Administrator of Linjiang of Zhou, led his troops in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guiwei: Zhou's Administrator of Linjiang Liu Xianguang surrendered with his troops.

sentences.zh: 是夜，天東南有聲，如風水相激，三夜乃止。

translations.literal: That night in the southeast of the sky there was a sound like wind and water clashing; after three nights it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: That night the southeast sky roared like wind and water colliding; after three nights it stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，周將王延貴率眾援曆陽，任忠擊破之，禽延貴等。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Zhou general Wang Yannui led troops to relieve Liyang; Ren Zhong routed him and captured Yannui and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhou general Wang Yannui marched to relieve Liyang; Ren Zhong routed him and captured Yannui and others.

sentences.zh: 己酉，周廣陵義軍主曹藥率眾來降。

translations.literal: On jiyou Cao Yao, leader of the righteous army of Guangling of Zhou, led his troops in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Cao Yao, leader of Guangling's righteous army under Zhou, surrendered with his men.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，大雨，震電。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, guichou, heavy rain fell with thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guichou: heavy rain with thunder.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，南徐州刺史河東王叔獻薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, gengchen, Prince Shuxian of Hedong, governor of Southern Xu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengchen: Prince Shuxian of Hedong, governor of Southern Xu, died.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月壬午，以中權將軍、護軍將軍鄱陽王伯山即本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, renwu of the thirteenth year, Central Guard General and Protector General Prince Boshan of Poyang received the Grand Precedence of the First Order under his existing title.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, renwu: Central Guard General and Protector General Prince Boshan of Poyang received Grand Precedence of the First Order under his existing title.

sentences.zh: 以尚書僕射晉安王伯恭為左僕射，吏部尚書袁憲為右僕射。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin'an Bokong, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director, and Yuan Xian, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin'an Bokong, Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Vice Director; Yuan Xian, Director of Personnel, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month, yihai, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 秋九月癸亥夜，大風從西北來，髮屋拔樹，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In autumn, ninth month, guihai night, a great wind came from the northwest, tore off roofs and uprooted trees, and heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, ninth month, guihai night: a northwest gale tore roofs and uprooted trees, and hail fell heavily.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，丹丹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, renyin, Dandan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, renyin: Dandan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，彗星見西南。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, xinsi, a comet appeared in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinsi: a comet appeared in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，周靜帝大定元年，遜位於隋文帝，改元開皇元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Dading of Zhou Emperor Jing, who abdicated to Emperor Wen of Sui and changed the era to the first year of Kaihuang.
translations.idiomatic: That year was Zhou Dading 1; Emperor Jing abdicated to Sui Emperor Wen and the era became Kaihuang 1.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月己酉，上弗豫。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, jiyou of the fourteenth year, the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, jiyou: the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，崩于宣福殿，時年五十三。

translations.literal: On jiayin he died in the Xuanfu Hall at the age of fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he died in the Xuanfu Hall, aged fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 遺詔：「凡厥終制，事從省約，金銀之飾，不以入壙，明器皆用瓦。

translations.literal: His final edict: "In all funeral arrangements let matters follow economy; gold and silver ornaments are not to enter the tomb; bright vessels are all to be of tile.
translations.idiomatic: His testament ran: "Let all funeral rites be spare; no gold or silver into the tomb; grave goods shall be earthenware only.

sentences.zh: 以日易月及公除之制，悉依舊准。

translations.literal: The systems of substituting days for months and of public mourning leave shall all follow the old standard.
translations.idiomatic: Rules substituting days for months and public mourning leave shall follow precedent.

sentences.zh: 在位百司，三日一臨。

translations.literal: Officials in attendance shall mourn once every three days.
translations.idiomatic: Attending officials shall mourn every third day.

sentences.zh: 四方州鎮，五等諸侯，各守所職，並停奔赴。

translations.literal: Provinces, garrisons, and feudatories of the fifth rank and above shall each keep their posts and cease rushing to court.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial garrisons and fifth-rank feudatories shall keep their posts and not hurry to court."

sentences.zh: 」二月辛卯，群臣上諡曰孝宣皇帝，廟號高宗。

translations.literal: In the second month, xinmao, the assembled ministers posthumously styled him Filial and Eminent Emperor with temple name High Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinmao: ministers posthumously styled him Filial and Eminent Emperor, temple name High Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，葬顯寧陵。

translations.literal: On guisi he was buried at Xianning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he was buried at Xianning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 帝之在田，本有恢弘之度，及居尊位，實允天人之屬。

translations.literal: When the Emperor was in private life he already possessed a broad and generous disposition; when he ascended the honored seat he truly matched what Heaven and men required.
translations.idiomatic: In private life he already showed broad magnanimity; on the throne he truly matched Heaven's and men's choice.

sentences.zh: 于時國步初弭，創痍未復，淮南之地，併入于齊。

translations.literal: At that time the state's step had just steadied and wounds were not yet healed; the lands south of the Huai had all been absorbed by Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The realm had only just steadied and wounds were unhealed; Huainan had already been lost to Qi.

sentences.zh: 帝志復舊境，意反侵地，強弱之形，理則縣絕，犯斯不韙，適足為禽。

translations.literal: The Emperor aspired to recover the old borders and win back seized territory, yet in the shape of strong and weak the logic hung far apart; committing this impropriety, he was fit only to be captured.
translations.idiomatic: He meant to recover old borders and lost land, but strength and weakness were worlds apart; by this rash breach he only made himself prey.

sentences.zh: 及周兵滅齊，乘勝而舉，略地還至江際，自此懼矣。

translations.literal: When Zhou's armies destroyed Qi he advanced on the momentum and pushed his conquests back to the river's edge; from this he grew afraid.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou destroyed Qi he rode the victory and pushed to the river's edge—and from that moment he feared.

sentences.zh: 既而修飾都城，為扞禦之備，獲銘云：「二百年後，當有癡人修破吾城者。

translations.literal: Thereafter he repaired the capital as defense and obtained an inscription that read: "Two hundred years hence, some fool will repair and break my walls.
translations.idiomatic: Then he fortified the capital for defense and found an inscription: "Two centuries hence some fool will repair my walls and break them."

sentences.zh: 」時莫測所從云。

translations.literal: At the time none could tell whence it came.
translations.idiomatic: None then knew its source.

sentences.zh: 後主諱叔寶，字元秀，小字黃奴，宣帝嫡長子也。

translations.literal: The Later Lord, taboo name Shubao, courtesy name Yuanxiu, childhood name Huangnu, was the eldest son born to the legitimate consort of Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Lord, personal name Shubao, style Yuanxiu, childhood name Huangnu, was Emperor Xuan's eldest son by the principal consort.

sentences.zh: 梁承聖二年十一月戊寅，生於江陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, wuyin, second year of Chengsheng of Liang, he was born at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Chengsheng 2, eleventh month, wuyin: he was born at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 明年，魏平江陵，宣帝遷于長安，留後主於穰城。

translations.literal: The next year Wei pacified Jiangling; Emperor Xuan was moved to Chang'an and the Later Lord was left at Rang city.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Wei took Jiangling; Emperor Xuan went to Chang'an and the Later Lord was left at Rang.

sentences.zh: 天嘉三年，歸建鄴，立為安成王世子。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancheng he returned to Jiankang and was installed as heir of the Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Tiancheng 3: he returned to Jiankang and was made heir of the Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 光大二年，累遷侍中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangda he was promoted in succession to Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Guangda 2: he rose in succession to Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 太建元年正月甲午，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taijian, first month, jiawu, he was installed as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Taijian 1, first month, jiawu: he was installed Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月甲寅，宣帝崩。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, first month, jiayin, Emperor Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, first month, jiayin: Emperor Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，始興王叔陵構逆伏誅。

translations.literal: On yimao Prince Shuling of Shixing plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Prince Shuling of Shixing plotted treason and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太子即皇帝位於太極前殿，大赦，在位文武及孝悌力田為父後者，並賜爵一級，孤老鰥寡不能自存者，賜穀人五斛、帛二匹。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Crown Prince took the throne in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate, proclaimed a general amnesty, granted one degree of nobility to civil and military officials in attendance and to the filial, the brotherly, field-tillers, and household heads, and gave five hu of grain and two bolts of silk to each orphaned elder, widower, or widow unable to support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Crown Prince ascended at the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate, declared general amnesty, raised one noble rank for attending officials and for the filial, brotherly, field-tillers, and household heads, and gave five hu of grain and two bolts of silk to each indigent orphan, elder, widower, or widow.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以侍中、丹陽尹、長沙王叔堅為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai Palace Attendant, Administrator of Danyang, and Prince of Changsha Shujian was made Cavalry General-in-Chief, Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order, and governor of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Palace Attendant Shujian, Prince of Changsha and Administrator of Danyang, became Cavalry General-in-Chief, Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order, and governor of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，尊皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: On yichou the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立皇弟叔重為始興王，奉昭烈王祀。

translations.literal: On dingmao the imperial younger brother Shuzhong was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing to maintain the rites of the Zhaolie Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the younger brother Shuzhong was created Prince of Shixing to keep the Zhaolie Prince's cult.

sentences.zh: 己巳，立妃沈氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jisi Consort Shen was installed as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Consort Shen became Empress.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立皇弟叔儼為尋陽王，叔慎為岳陽王，叔達為義陽王，叔熊為巴山王，叔虞為武昌王。

translations.literal: On xinwei the imperial younger brothers Shuyan were enfeoffed as Prince of Xunyang, Shushen as Prince of Yueyang, Shuda as Prince of Yiyang, Shuxiong as Prince of Bashan, and Shuyu as Prince of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei younger brothers Shuyan became Prince of Xunyang, Shushen Prince of Yueyang, Shuda Prince of Yiyang, Shuxiong Prince of Bashan, and Shuyu Prince of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，設無礙大會於太極前殿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an Unhindered Assembly was held in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an Unhindered Assembly was held in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，詔內外眾官九品以上，各薦一人。

translations.literal: In the third month, guihai, an edict ordered all officials within and without the palace of the ninth rank and above each to recommend one man.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guihai: an edict ordered every official of ninth rank and above inside and outside the palace to recommend one man.

sentences.zh: 又詔求忠讜，無所隱諱。

translations.literal: Another edict sought loyal remonstrance without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict sought loyal remonstrance without reserve.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以新除翊左將軍永陽王伯智為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On jisi the newly appointed General of the Left Wing Prince Bokong of Yongyang was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the newly appointed General of the Left Wing Prince Bokong of Yongyang became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，立皇子永康公胤為皇太子，賜天下為父後者爵一級，王公以下賚帛各有差。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, bingshen, Duke Yongkang Yin was installed as Crown Prince; those who headed their fathers' households throughout the realm received one degree of nobility, and nobles and officials received graded gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingshen: Duke Yongkang Yin became Crown Prince; household heads empire-wide received one noble rank and nobles and officials graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔：「鏤金銀薄、庶物化生、土木人、彩華之屬，及布帛短狹輕疏者，並傷財廢業，尤成蠹患。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict read: "Inlay of gold and silver leaf, artificial creatures, clay and wood figures, painted ornamentation, and the like, together with cloth and silk that is short, narrow, light, or loose—all waste wealth, ruin livelihoods, and breed especially pernicious harm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict declared: "Gold and silver inlay, artificial creatures, clay and wood figures, painted gewgaws, and short or flimsy cloth—all waste wealth, ruin trades, and breed ruinous vice.

sentences.zh: 又僧尼道士，挾邪左道，不依經律，人間淫祀祅書諸珍怪事，詳為條制，並皆禁絕。」

translations.literal: Monks, nuns, and Daoist priests who embrace heterodox ways and do not follow canonical discipline, together with illicit popular cults, demonic writings, and all strange marvels among the people, are to be regulated in detail and wholly forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Monks, nuns, and Daoists who follow heterodox ways, together with illicit cults, demonic writings, and popular marvels, shall be banned by detailed regulation."

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，大赦。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, xinwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, xinwei: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是月，自建鄴至荊州，江水色赤如血。

translations.literal: That month from Jiankang to Jing Province the Yangzi's waters turned red as blood.
translations.idiomatic: That month from Jiankang to Jing Province the Yangzi ran red as blood.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，天有聲如風水相激。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, guiwei, the sky gave a sound like wind and water clashing.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guiwei: the sky roared like wind and water colliding.

sentences.zh: 乙酉夜，又如之。

translations.literal: On the night of yiyou it happened again.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yiyou it happened again.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，天東南有聲如蟲飛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, dingsi, the southeast sky gave a sound like insects flying.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingsi: the southeast sky hummed like swarming insects.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁酉，立皇弟叔平為湘東王，叔敖為臨賀王，叔宣為陽山王，叔穆為西陽王，叔儉為南安王，叔澄為南郡王，叔興為沅陵王，叔韶為岳山王，叔純為新興王。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, dingyou, the imperial younger brothers Shuping were enfeoffed as Prince of Xiangdong, Shu'ao as Prince of Linhe, Shuxuan as Prince of Yangshan, Shumu as Prince of Xiyang, Shujian as Prince of Nan'an, Shucheng as Prince of Nan, Shuxing as Prince of Yuanling, Shushao as Prince of Yueshan, and Shuchun as Prince of Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, dingyou: younger brothers Shuping became Prince of Xiangdong, Shu'ao Prince of Linhe, Shuxuan Prince of Yangshan, Shumu Prince of Xiyang, Shujian Prince of Nan'an, Shucheng Prince of Nan, Shuxing Prince of Yuanling, Shushao Prince of Yueshan, and Shuchun Prince of Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，頭和國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, bingchen, Touhe sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingchen: Touhe sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 司空、長沙王叔堅有罪免。

translations.literal: Minister of Works and Prince of Changsha Shujian was removed from office for crime.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works and Prince of Changsha Shujian was dismissed for crime.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，天開，自西北至東南，其內有青黃雜色，隆隆若雷聲。

translations.literal: At midnight on wuwu the sky opened from the northwest to the southeast; within were mixed azure and yellow hues, rumbling like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Midnight, wuwu: the sky split from northwest to southeast in mixed azure and yellow, rumbling like thunder.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁卯，分遣大使，巡省風俗。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, dingmao of the second year, grand envoys were separately dispatched to tour and inspect customs.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, dingmao: grand envoys toured customs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大赦。

translations.literal: On guisi a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊子，以吏部尚書江總為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, wuzi, Jiang Zong, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, wuzi: Jiang Zong, Director of Personnel, became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，皇太子加元服，在位文武賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, renwu, the Crown Prince received the capping ceremony; civil and military officials in attendance received graded gifts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, renwu: the Crown Prince was capped; attending officials received graded silk.

sentences.zh: 孝悌力田為父後者，賜爵一級；

translations.literal: The filial, the brotherly, and those who tilled fields by their own labor and headed their fathers' households received one degree of nobility;
translations.idiomatic: The filial, the brotherly, field-tillers, and household heads received one noble rank;

sentences.zh: 鰥寡癃老不能自存者，人穀五斛。

translations.literal: widowers, widows, the aged, and the infirm unable to support themselves received five hu of grain each.
translations.idiomatic: indigent widowers, widows, and the aged and infirm received five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙寅，大赦。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, bingyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, bingyin: general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是月，盤盤、百濟國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That month Panpan and Baekje both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Panpan and Baekje both sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, wuwu, first day of the month, of the third year, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, wuwu, new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚午，鎮左將軍長沙王叔堅即本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengwu General of the Left Wing Prince Shujian of Changsha received the Grand Precedence of the First Order under his existing title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Prince Shujian of Changsha, General of the Left Wing, received Grand Precedence of the First Order under his existing title.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，前豐州刺史章大寶舉兵反。

translations.literal: In the third month, xinyou, the former Administrator of Feng Province Zhang Dabao raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinyou: former Administrator of Feng Zhang Dabao rebelled.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，豐州義軍主陳景詳斬大寶，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, gengxu, Chen Jingxiang, leader of the righteous army of Feng Province, beheaded Dabao and sent his head to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, gengxu: Chen Jingxiang, leader of Feng's righteous army, beheaded Dabao and sent his head to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，丹丹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, jichou, Dandan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jichou: Dandan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，詔修復仲尼廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, jiwei, an edict ordered repair of Confucius's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiwei: an edict ordered Confucius's temple restored.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸長幹寺，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinsi he visited Changgan Temple and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he visited Changgan Temple and declared general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, guimao, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guimao: Goguryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 是歲，梁明帝殂。

translations.literal: That year Emperor Ming of Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Liang Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲寅，詔王公以下各薦所知，無隔輿皁。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, jiayin of the fourth year, an edict ordered nobles and officials downward each to recommend men they knew without regard to carriage or commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, jiayin: an edict ordered nobles and officials to recommend known talent regardless of rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，立皇弟叔謨為巴東王，叔顯為臨江王，叔坦為新會王，叔隆為新甯王。

translations.literal: In the second month, bingshen, the imperial younger brothers Shumo were enfeoffed as Prince of Badong, Shuxian as Prince of Linjiang, Shutan as Prince of Xinhui, and Shulong as Prince of Xinning.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingshen: younger brothers Shumo became Prince of Badong, Shuxian Prince of Linjiang, Shutan Prince of Xinhui, and Shulong Prince of Xinning.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丁巳，立皇子莊為會稽王。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, dingsi, Prince Zhuang was enfeoffed as Prince of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, dingsi: Prince Zhuang was created Prince of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 秋九月甲午，幸玄武湖，肄艫艦閱武。

translations.literal: In autumn, ninth month, jiawu, he visited Black Tortoise Lake and reviewed martial exercises with warships.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, ninth month, jiawu: he reviewed warship drills at Black Tortoise Lake.

sentences.zh: 丁未，百濟國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingwei Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Baekje sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，以尚書僕射江總為尚書令，吏部尚書謝侑為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, guihai, Jiang Zong, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing with chief authority, and Xie You, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guihai: Jiang Zong became Director of the Masters of Writing with chief authority; Xie You, Director of Personnel, Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙子，以蕭岩為平東將軍、開府儀同三司、東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, bingzi, Xiao Yan was made General of the East-Pacifying Army, Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order, and governor of Eastern Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, bingzi: Xiao Yan became General of the East-Pacifying Army, Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order, and governor of Eastern Yang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司豫章王叔英為兼司徒。

translations.literal: On dinghai Cavalry General-in-Chief Prince Shuying of Yuzhang was made Concurrent Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Cavalry General-in-Chief Prince Shuying of Yuzhang became Concurrent Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，以前鎮衛大將軍、開府儀同三司、東揚州刺史鄱陽王伯山為鎮衛大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, bingchen, the former Garrison General, Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order, and governor of Eastern Yang Prince Boshan of Poyang was made Garrison General and Commissioner with the Grand Precedence of the First Order.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingchen: former Garrison General Prince Boshan of Poyang, Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order and governor of Eastern Yang, became Garrison General and Commissioner with Grand Precedence of the First Order.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳，立皇子恮為東陽王，恬為錢唐王。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, xinsi of the second year, Prince Quan was enfeoffed as Prince of Dongyang and Prince Tian as Prince of Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, xinsi: Prince Quan became Prince of Dongyang and Prince Tian Prince of Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，有群鼠無數，自蔡洲岸入石頭，渡淮至於青塘兩岸，數日自死，隨流出江。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, wushen, countless rats came from the Cai Isle shore into Shitou, crossed the Huai to both banks of Qingtang, died after several days, and were carried out with the current into the river.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, wushen: countless rats came from Cai Isle into Shitou, crossed the Huai to Qingtang's both banks, died within days, and floated out on the current.

sentences.zh: 是月，郢州南浦水黑如墨。

translations.literal: That month the waters of Nanpu in E Province were black as ink.
translations.idiomatic: That month Nanpu waters in E Province turned black as ink.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，東冶鑄鐵，有物赤色，大如數升，自天墜鎔所，有聲隆隆如雷，鐵飛出牆外，燒人家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, jiawu, at the Eastern Works iron was being cast when a red object the size of several sheng fell from heaven into the smelting site with a rumble like thunder; molten iron flew outside the wall and burned people's houses.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiawu: at the Eastern Works a red mass several sheng in size fell into the smelter with thunderous roar; molten iron flew over the wall and burned houses.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，扶南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, wuxu, Funan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuxu: Funan sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚子，廢皇太子胤為吳興王，立揚州刺史始安王深為皇太子。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Crown Prince Yin was deposed as Prince of Wuxing and Prince Shen of Shi'an, governor of Yangzhou, was installed as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Crown Prince Yin was deposed as Prince of Wuxing and Prince Shen of Shi'an, governor of Yangzhou, was made Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以太子詹事袁憲為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On xinchou Yuan Xian, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yuan Xian, Grand Mentor of the Heir, became Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大風自西北激濤水入石頭城，淮渚暴溢，漂沒舟乘。

translations.literal: On dingsi a great wind from the northwest drove the surging waters into Shitou city; the Huai's shallows overflowed violently and drowned boats.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a northwest gale drove floodwaters into Shitou; the Huai shallows burst and drowned boats.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，立皇子藩為吳王。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, jihai, Prince Fan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jihai: Prince Fan was created Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸莫府山，大校獵。

translations.literal: On jiyou he visited Mofu Mountain and held a great hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he visited Mofu Mountain for a great hunt.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，詔克日於大政殿訊獄。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, dingmao, an edict fixed a day at the Hall of Great Governance for hearing cases.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingmao: an edict fixed a day at the Hall of Great Governance to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立皇弟叔榮為新昌王，叔匡為太原王。

translations.literal: On bingzi the imperial younger brothers Shurong were enfeoffed as Prince of Xinchang and Shukuang as Prince of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi younger brothers Shurong became Prince of Xinchang and Shukuang Prince of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 初隋文帝受周禪，甚敦鄰好，宣帝尚不禁侵掠。

translations.literal: At first when Emperor Wen of Sui received Zhou's abdication he was very earnest in neighborly friendship, yet Emperor Xuan still did not forbid raiding.
translations.idiomatic: When Sui Emperor Wen took Zhou's abdication he cultivated neighborly friendship, yet Emperor Xuan still tolerated border raids.

sentences.zh: 太建末，隋兵大舉，聞宣帝崩，乃命班師，遣使赴吊，修敵國之禮，書稱姓名頓首。

translations.literal: At the end of Taijian Sui armies marched in force; hearing that Emperor Xuan had died, they ordered withdrawal, sent envoys to offer condolences, observed the rites due a rival state, and in their letter used their names with bowed heads.
translations.idiomatic: At Taijian's end Sui marched in force; learning Emperor Xuan had died, they withdrew, sent mourners, observed rival-state rites, and signed their letter with bowed heads.

sentences.zh: 而後主益驕，書末云：「想彼統內如宜，此宇宙清泰。

translations.literal: But the Later Lord grew more arrogant and at the letter's end wrote: "We trust all is well within your realm; here the cosmos is clear and tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Lord grew haughtier and added: "We trust all is well in your realm; here the cosmos is clear and calm."

sentences.zh: 」隋文帝不說，以示朝臣。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui was displeased and showed it to his court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Sui Emperor Wen was displeased and showed the letter to court.

sentences.zh: 清河公楊素以為主辱，再拜請罪，及襄邑公賀若弼並奮求致討。

translations.literal: Duke of Qinghe Yang Su considered it an insult to the ruler and twice bowed to ask punishment; Duke of Xiangyi He Ruo also clamored to launch an attack.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Qinghe Yang Su called it an insult to the throne and twice bowed begging punishment; Duke of Xiangyi He Ruo also clamored for war.

sentences.zh: 後副使袁彥聘隋，竊圖隋文帝狀以歸，後主見之，大駭曰：「吾不欲見此人。

translations.literal: Later the deputy envoy Yuan Yan went on mission to Sui, secretly sketched Emperor Wen's likeness and returned; when the Later Lord saw it he was greatly alarmed and said: "I do not wish to see this man.
translations.idiomatic: Later deputy envoy Yuan Yan missioned to Sui, secretly sketched Emperor Wen, and returned; the Later Lord was terrified and said, "I do not wish to see this man."

sentences.zh: 」每遣間諜，隋文帝皆給衣馬，禮遣以歸。

translations.literal: Whenever he sent spies, Emperor Wen of Sui gave them clothes and horses and sent them back with courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he sent spies, Sui Emperor Wen clothed and horsed them and courteously sent them home.

sentences.zh: 後主愈驕，不虞外難，荒於酒色，不恤政事，左右嬖佞珥貂者五十人，婦人美貌麗服巧態以從者千餘人。

translations.literal: The Later Lord grew ever more arrogant, gave no thought to external peril, indulged in wine and women, and neglected governance; fifty favored sycophants with ermine tails attended him, and more than a thousand beautiful women in splendid dress with artful grace followed.
translations.idiomatic: He grew ever haughtier, ignored external danger, drowned in wine and women, and neglected rule; fifty sycophants with ermine tails attended him and more than a thousand painted women followed.

sentences.zh: 常使張貴妃、孔貴人等八人夾坐，江總、孔範等十人預宴，號曰：「狎客」。

translations.literal: He regularly seated the Noble Consorts Zhang and Kong and six others on either side, with Jiang Zong, Kong Fan, and ten others joining the feast; they were called the "Intimate Guests."
translations.idiomatic: He regularly seated Noble Consorts Zhang and Kong and six others on either side, with Jiang Zong, Kong Fan, and ten others at feast—they were called the "Intimate Guests."

sentences.zh: 先令八婦人襞采箋，制五言詩，十客一時繼和，遲則罰酒。

translations.literal: First he had the eight women fold colored paper and compose five-character poems; the ten guests had to continue in turn, and tardiness was punished with wine.
translations.idiomatic: First the eight women folded colored paper and wrote five-character lines; the ten guests had to match in turn, and lateness meant a wine penalty.

sentences.zh: 君臣酣飲，從夕達旦，以此為常。

translations.literal: Ministers and ruler drank deep from evening till dawn; this became their constant way.
translations.idiomatic: Court and ruler drank from dusk to dawn as daily habit.

sentences.zh: 而盛修宮室，無時休止。

translations.literal: Yet he lavishly built palaces without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he built palaces lavishly without pause.

sentences.zh: 稅江稅市，征取百端。

translations.literal: Taxes on the river and the market were levied from every quarter.
translations.idiomatic: River tolls and market taxes were exacted on every side.

sentences.zh: 刑罰酷濫，牢獄常滿。

translations.literal: Punishments were cruel and excessive; prisons were constantly full.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments ran cruel and excessive; prisons stayed full.

sentences.zh: 覆舟山及蔣山柏林，冬月常多采醴，後主以為甘露之瑞。

translations.literal: On Mount Fu and the cypress groves of Mount Jiang, in winter months they often gathered much sweet sap; the Later Lord took this as an auspice of sweet dew.
translations.idiomatic: On Mount Fu and Mount Jiang's cypress groves they often gathered sweet sap in winter; the Later Lord took it for sweet-dew omens.

sentences.zh: 前後災異甚多。

translations.literal: Before and after, calamities and portents were very many.
translations.idiomatic: Calamities and portents were many.

sentences.zh: 有神自稱老子，游於都下，與人對語而不見形，言吉凶多驗，得酒輒釂之，經三四年乃去。

translations.literal: A spirit calling itself Laozi wandered in the capital, conversing with people though none could see his form; his words of fortune and misfortune mostly proved true; given wine he would drain it, and after three or four years he departed.
translations.idiomatic: A spirit calling itself Laozi wandered the capital, speaking though unseen; his omens mostly held true; given wine he drained the cup, and after three or four years vanished.

sentences.zh: 船下有聲云：「明年亂」。

translations.literal: Beneath a boat a voice said: "Next year, chaos."
translations.idiomatic: Under a boat a voice said, "Chaos next year."

sentences.zh: 視之，得嬰兒長三尺而無頭。

translations.literal: When they looked, they found an infant three chi long without a head.
translations.idiomatic: Looking, they found a headless infant three chi long.

sentences.zh: 蔣山眾鳥鼓兩翼以拊膺，曰：「奈何帝！

translations.literal: Birds on Mount Jiang beat their wings against their breasts and cried: "What shall we do, O Emperor!
translations.idiomatic: Birds on Mount Jiang beat their wings on their breasts crying, "What shall we do, O Emperor!

sentences.zh: 奈何帝！

translations.literal: What shall we do, O Emperor!
translations.idiomatic: What shall we do, O Emperor!"

sentences.zh: 」又建鄴城無故自壞。

translations.literal: Jiankang's walls also collapsed for no reason.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang's walls collapsed without cause.

sentences.zh: 青龍出建陽門，井湧霧，赤地生黑白毛，大風拔朱雀門，臨平湖草舊塞，忽然自通。

translations.literal: A green dragon emerged from the Jianyang Gate; wells spewed mist; black and white hair grew on red earth; a great wind uprooted the Vermilion Bird Gate; grass that had long blocked Linping Lake suddenly opened a passage.
translations.idiomatic: A green dragon came from Jianyang Gate; wells spewed mist; black and white hair sprouted on red earth; gale winds uprooted the Vermilion Bird Gate; long-blocked Linping Lake grass suddenly opened a channel.

sentences.zh: 後主又夢黃衣人圍城，乃盡去繞城橘樹。

translations.literal: The Later Lord also dreamed of men in yellow surrounding the city, and had all the orange trees around the walls removed.
translations.idiomatic: He dreamed of men in yellow besieging the city and had every orange tree around the walls cut down.

sentences.zh: 又見大蛇中分，首尾各走。

translations.literal: He also saw a great serpent split in two, head and tail each going its way.
translations.idiomatic: He also saw a great serpent split in two, head and tail fleeing apart.

sentences.zh: 夜中索飲，忽變為血。

translations.literal: At midnight he asked for drink and it suddenly turned to blood.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight he called for drink and it turned to blood.

sentences.zh: 有血沾階至於坐床頭而火起。

translations.literal: Blood stained the steps to the bedside and fire broke out.
translations.idiomatic: Blood stained the steps to his bed and fire broke out.

sentences.zh: 有狐入其床下，捕之不見。

translations.literal: A fox entered beneath his bed; though they hunted it, none could be seen.
translations.idiomatic: A fox entered under his bed; though hunted, it could not be found.

sentences.zh: 以為祅，乃自賣於佛寺為奴以禳之。

translations.literal: Taking this for demonic harm, he sold himself as a slave to a Buddhist temple to avert it.
translations.idiomatic: Deeming it demonic, he sold himself as a temple slave to avert it.

sentences.zh: 于郭內大皇佛寺起七層塔，未畢，火從中起，飛至石頭，燒死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Within the city at Dahuang Buddhist Temple a seven-story pagoda was raised; before it was finished fire broke out in its midst, flew to Shitou, and burned many to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Dahuang Temple in the city they raised a seven-story pagoda; before completion fire burst from its center, flew to Shitou, and burned many dead.

sentences.zh: 又采木湘州，擬造正寢，筏至牛渚磯，盡沒水中，既而漁人見筏浮於海上。

translations.literal: Timber was also gathered in Xiang Province to build the main hall; when the raft reached Niuzhu Jetty it all sank; afterward fishermen saw the raft floating on the sea.
